title: Old Noah
transcription:
Old Noah

The Lord said to Noah
"there's going to be a floody, floody,"
Lord said to Noah
"there's going to be a floody, floody;
Everything is gonna get muddy, muddy,"
Children of the Lord.

Refrain (sung between verses):
So rise and shine,
and give out your glory glory,
Rise and shine and give out your glory,
glory,
Everything is hunky dory, dory,
Children of the Lord.

Old Noah he built him,
he built him an arky, arkey,
Noah he built him,
he built him an arkey, arkey,
Built it out of hickory barky, barky,
Children of the Lord.

He marched in the animals by two-sies,
by two-sies two-sies,
Marched in the animals by two-sies,
by two-sies two-sies,
Elephants and kangaroo-sies, roo-sies,
Children of the Lord.

It rained and poured
for forty daysies, daysies,
Rained and poured for
forty daysies, daysies,
Nearly drove those
animals crazy, crazy,
Children of the Lord.
The sun came out
and dried up the landy, landy,
Sun came out and dried up
the landy, landy,
Everything was
fine and dandy, dandy,
Children of the Lord.

He marched out the animals
by three-sies, by three-sies, three-sies,
Marched out the animals
by three-sies, by three-sie, three-sies,
Comes from them old
birds and bee-sies, bee-sies,
Children of the Lord.

Now this is the end of,
the end of my story, story,
This is the end of,
the end of my story, story,
Everything is hunky dory, dory,
Children of the Lord.
